workspace.view.plan.desc: Draw and edit on the current level.
workspace.view.3d.desc: Orbit the whole model. The plan keeps its zoom.
workspace.view.split.desc: Switches to the Plan + 3D layout. Selection is shared between both views.
workspace.layout.desc: How the window is arranged. Selection, tool, undo and cameras stay as they are.
workspace.pop.title: Layout
workspace.purpose.classic: Full ribbon, browser and properties, everything in view.
workspace.purpose.context: Commands appear next to the selection.
workspace.purpose.split: Plan and 3D side by side with one selection.
workspace.purpose.focus: Only the model. Commands come from the palette.
workspace.purpose.data: Model above, an editable schedule below.
cmd.ui.layout.back: Switch back to the previous layout
cmd.ui.layout.back.desc: Returns to the layout used before the last switch. Press again to go forward.
